content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable and Stripe provide a user-friendly experience for selling courses, with built-in payment processing and delivery mechanisms. However, their geographic limitations mean creators outside their operational regions are left stranded. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack, offers a robust alternative. It enables creators to host their own online store using Cloudflare Pages, manage backend logic with Workers, and utilize NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions. This architecture allows for complete ownership of your digital products, ensuring you’re never at the mercy of platform constraints.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like PayPal and Gumroad often exclude countries based on risk assessments tied to regulatory compliance. For instance, a PayPal account suspension can lock funds for up to 180 days, with no clear path for recourse. This creates financial uncertainty for creators attempting to monetize their content. In contrast, sovereign commerce solutions are inherently designed to be accessible from anywhere, focusing on infrastructure sovereignty rather than compliance with arbitrary restrictions. This means that creators can operate without the fear of account freezes or payment interruptions, allowing for a stable income stream.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When evaluating payment options, speed and fees are critical considerations. Traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal often charge high transaction fees and can take days to settle payments. Additionally, hidden fees can accumulate rapidly, impacting your bottom line. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, particularly through NOWPayments, offers competitive fees of just 0.5% with immediate payment confirmation on-chain. This creates a reliable cash flow for creators, as transactions are settled in real-time with low-cost networks like BSC and Solana, ensuring that creators keep more of their earnings.
Sovereign commerce ensures you own everything after deployment.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of your digital products is crucial for long-term success. Teachable and Stripe require you to operate within their ecosystems, meaning they retain control over your products and customer data. In contrast, using a setup like the Edge Commerce Stack allows you to maintain complete ownership of your products and customer relationships. With automated delivery mechanisms, you can ensure that customers receive their purchases instantly and securely. This level of automation not only improves customer satisfaction but also frees up valuable time for creators to focus on developing new content.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice of architecture ultimately depends on your specific circumstances and goals. If you are in a country restricted by mainstream payment platforms, transitioning to a sovereign commerce stack is the most logical step. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a comprehensive solution that is deployed within 48 hours, offering built-in payment processing, product delivery, and full control over your digital assets. If you need guidance on setting this up, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) offers detailed documentation to help you get started.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Avoid account freezes and fund locks with alternative payment infrastructures.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
